classes.name: Zgjedhjet për Kuvendin
classes.locator: https://kqz.gov.al/pdf/kushtetuta-ndryshuar.pdf (neni 64: 140 deputetë, sistem proporcional me konkurrim rajonal; neni 65: çdo 4 vjet)
classes.note: Multiparty elections since 31 March 1991. The systems changed often: 250 single-member seats in 1991, mixed member systems with 100 to 115 districts from 1992 to 2005, and regional list proportional representation in the 12 counties since 2009 (a D'Hondt divisor count per county among lists with at least 1 percent of the national vote, Code art. 162). Voters abroad cast ballots by post for the first time in 2025. The Commission's results page links each election from 2001; 1991-1997 results are not published online by the Commission.

classes.name: Zgjedhjet e pjesshme për Kuvendin
classes.locator: https://kqz.gov.al/pdf/kodi-zgjedhor.pdf (neni 164: a vacant seat passes to the next candidate on the same list)
classes.note: Until 2009 a vacant single-member seat was filled by a partial election in its district. Since the 2008 Code a vacancy passes to the next candidate on the list, so no by-elections are held. The Commission lists none of the earlier ones.

cadence.vacancy_rule: Since 2009 the next candidate on the party's list in the same constituency takes the seat (Code art. 164)

classes.name: Zgjedhja e Presidentit të Republikës nga Kuvendi
classes.name_en: President of the Republic, elected by the Assembly
classes.locator: https://kqz.gov.al/pdf/kushtetuta-ndryshuar.pdf (neni 87: secret vote of the Assembly, up to five ballots, three fifths of all members in the first three, a majority after; neni 88: five years, one re-election)
classes.note: The Assembly elects the president; if five ballots fail it is dissolved and a general election follows (art. 87(5)). Final votes: 30 April 1991, 9 April 1992, 23 July 1996, 24 July 1997, 24 June 2002, 20 July 2007, 11 June 2012, 28 April 2017, and 4 June 2022. The Assembly's minutes are the record.

cadence.locator: https://kqz.gov.al/pdf/kushtetuta-ndryshuar.pdf (neni 88, pika 2/1: the procedure starts no later than 60 days before the term ends)

classes.name: Referendumet kombëtare
classes.locator: https://kqz.gov.al/pdf/kushtetuta-ndryshuar.pdf (neni 150: 50,000 voters or the Assembly may call one; neni 152: the President sets the date, one referendum day a year; neni 177: constitutional referendums)
classes.note: Three national referendums: the draft constitution rejected on 6 November 1994, the monarchy question on 29 June 1997 (held with the Assembly election), and the 1998 Constitution approved on 22 November 1998. No official results publication is online; the Commission's results page lists none.

classes.name: Zgjedhjet për kryetarët e bashkive (dhe të komunave deri në 2015)
classes.name_en: Mayors of municipalities (and of communes until 2015), general local elections
classes.locator: https://kqz.gov.al/pdf/kodi-zgjedhor.pdf (neni 165: mayors and councils are elected directly; neni 166: the candidate with the most valid votes wins)
classes.note: Mayors of the 61 municipalities since 2015; before then of 65 municipalities and over 300 communes (373 units in 2011). Elected by plurality in one round. The Commission's results page links each local election from 2003; 2023 is on IEMIS with mayoral votes by voting center.

classes.name: Zgjedhjet e pjesshme për kryetar bashkie
classes.locator: https://kqz.gov.al/pdf/kodi-zgjedhor.pdf (neni 10, pika 3: within 30 to 45 days when a mandate ends early)
classes.note: Held when a mayor's mandate ends early: six municipalities on 6 March 2022, Kukës on 24 September 2023, Himarë on 4 August 2024, and Vlorë, Berat, Tepelenë, Cërrik, and Mat on 9 November 2025 (Tiranë's was suspended by the Constitutional Court). Earlier partial elections are not listed by the Commission. Council vacancies pass down the list and are never contested (Code art. 161(5) and 164(2)).

cadence.vacancy_rule: A by-election 30 to 45 days after the mandate ends; the President sets the date within 48 hours (Code art. 10(3))

classes.name: Referendumet vendore
classes.locator: https://kqz.gov.al/pdf/kushtetuta-ndryshuar.pdf (neni 108, pika 4: self-government through representative organs and local referendums, by law)
classes.note: Provided for by the Constitution and Law 139/2015 (initiative for local referendums), but the Commission's results page lists none and no held local referendum was found.

classes.name: Këshilli i qarkut
classes.name_en: County councils, delegated by the municipal councils
classes.disposition_reason: Mayors sit ex officio and each municipal council delegates further members from among its councillors by proportional lists (Constitution art. 110(3), Law 139/2015 art. 73); no public vote and no published results.

classes.name: Kryesia dhe kryetari i fshatit
classes.disposition_reason: Members are chosen at a village meeting attended by at least half the voters, under voting rules each municipal council sets, and the head is chosen by the presidency from its members (Law 139/2015 art. 70); the Commission does not run or publish them.

classes.name: Anëtarët gjyqtarë dhe prokurorë të KLGJ dhe KLP
classes.name_en: Judge and prosecutor members of the High Judicial and High Prosecutorial Councils
classes.disposition_reason: Six members of each council are elected by the judges or prosecutors themselves and five by the Assembly; the electorate is the profession, not the public.

classes.name: Zgjedhjet brenda partive
classes.locator: https://kqz.gov.al/pdf/kodi-zgjedhor.pdf (neni 67: parties submit their own candidate lists)
classes.disposition_reason: Parties choose leaders and candidates under their own statutes; the state neither runs nor publishes these votes.

classes.name: Kuvendi Popullor (1945-1987)
classes.name_en: People's Assembly under the single-list system, 1945-1987
classes.disposition_reason: Single-list elections from the Constituent Assembly of 2 December 1945 to 1 February 1987; no official results publication is online and the Commission's results page starts in 2001.

classes.name: Parlamenti dhe asambletë kushtetuese (1920-1939)
classes.name_en: Parliaments and constituent assemblies of the principality and kingdom, 1920-1939
classes.disposition_reason: Indirect two-stage elections between the wars; no official results publication is online.
